patches.name: Uncensor patch
patches.notes: Install (PC): Open the Steam game install folder (right click the game in Steam, Properties, Local Files, Browse Local Files...). Inside that directory, there will be a folder named 'game'. Download the patch archive from the link below Extract the '004f.rpa' file from the downloaded patch archive into the 'game' folder mentioned above, overwriting the existing file when prompted It's working if: If there are no messages to download the h-scenes on the title screen.
